runtime_gate: Mutation/collision tests prove unrelated rows cannot satisfy reconcile identity; process-loss integration test resolves only original command.
qa_comment: Adapter concatenates row values and uses substring contains() for commandRequestId/idempotencyKey/approvalRequestId; any one partial match can select an unrelated log row. | risk=Wrong UNKNOWN may be finalized SUCCEEDED/FAILED, causing false terminal state and potential duplicate/incorrect recovery decisions.

consumer_path: CpfFileLogWriter append failure -> recoverySpool.enqueue -> startup/next-append/close replay
runtime_gate: Hard-kill + restart + no-new-write test, disk-full/read-only recovery, corrupt spool quarantine, duplicate replay and terminal-loss metrics.
qa_comment: Default spool root is java.io.tmpdir; replay is driven only at writer startup, next append, or close. Hard kill skips close; ephemeral tmp storage may be lost; after startup a failed replay has no autonomous retry if no further write occurs. | risk=File log loss or indefinite stranded spool in precisely the process-kill/disk-recovery cases the requirement covers.

runtime_gate: Mutations must be killed; fault tests must generate exact-SHA evidence.
qa_comment: Current test uses temp dir + explicit replay; verifier mainly checks source tokens/functions. It does not prove hard kill, restart persistence, autonomous retry, disk full, corruption, or terminal alert. | risk=Static PASS can remain green while production recovery semantics are broken.

runtime_gate: One-shot tests for pure local, local+remote, message, batch, DLQ and mixed partial-failure transactions.
qa_comment: sourceFreshness expects LOCAL, REMOTE, MESSAGE, DLQ, BATCH, FILE, TRACE, AUDIT for every transaction. A normal transaction that never uses one of those channels can be reported as missing/partial. | risk=False operational degradation and incorrect incident/recovery decisions.
